claim: Solid colors occupy a 3-D subspace of the FLUX VAE latent
published: first three PCs explain essentially 100% of variance (Pach et al. 2026, §3)
ours: top-3 PCs explain 96.14% over 400 colors (random-noise images: 60.1%)

claim: The subspace is HSL-like: lightness axis, hue angle, saturation radius
published: PC1 = lightness; PC2–PC3 angle = hue; radius = saturation (bicone, Fig. 2)
ours: corr(PC1, lightness) 0.98; circular corr(angle, hue) 0.99; corr(radius, chroma) 0.93

claim: Confirmatory control: the HSL bicone is learned (random-init VAE)
published: the bicone reflects the trained VAE's colour representation
ours: min(r_light, r_hue, r_sat): trained 0.93 vs random-init VAE 0.08 (0.51 / 0.75 / 0.08); PCA of the RGB values themselves 0.40 (reported)
